const grain = `
  vec3 stipple(vec2 pixel, float amount) {
    vec2 p = floor(pixel);
    float a = mod(p.x + 2.0*p.y, 4.0);
    float b = mod(2.0*p.x + p.y + floor(p.y/4.0), 5.0);
    float fleck = fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(p,vec2(.06711056,.00583715))))-.5;
    float chroma = (a-1.5)/1.5;
    float value = (b-2.)*.012 + fleck*.032;
    return amount*(vec3(.058,.008,-.082)*chroma + value);
  }
`;

    precision highp float;
    varying vec3 pigment;
    varying vec3 worldNormal;
    varying vec3 viewDirection;

      vec3 n=normalize(worldNormal), v=normalize(viewDirection);

      float rim=pow(1.-clamp(dot(n,v),0.,1.),2.5)*

const clamp = (x,a=0,b=1) => Math.min(b,Math.max(a,x));
const mix = (a,b,t) => a+(b-a)*t;
const blend = (a,b,t) => a.map((v,i)=>mix(v,b[i],t));
function smooth(a,b,x) {
  const t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a));
  return t*t*(3-2*t);
}
function spot(x,y,cx,cy,rx,ry) {
  return Math.exp(-((x-cx)/rx)**2 - ((y-cy)/ry)**2);
}
function palette(table,y) {
  let i=0;
  while(i<table.length-2 && y>table[i+1][0]) i++;
  const a=table[i], b=table[i+1];
  return blend(a.slice(1),b.slice(1),smooth(a[0],b[0],y));
}

// A profile row contains a longitudinal coordinate followed by section dimensions.
function section(table,y) {
  let i=0;
  while(i<table.length-2 && y>table[i+1][0]) i++;
  const a=table[i], b=table[i+1], p=table[Math.max(0,i-1)], q=table[Math.min(table.length-1,i+2)];
  const d=b[0]-a[0], t=clamp((y-a[0])/d), t2=t*t, t3=t2*t;
  return a.slice(1).map((v,k)=>{
    const j=k+1;
    const m=(b[j]-p[j])*d/(b[0]-p[0]);
    const n=(q[j]-a[j])*d/(q[0]-a[0]);
    return (2*t3-3*t2+1)*v+(t3-2*t2+t)*m+
           (-2*t3+3*t2)*b[j]+(t3-t2)*n;
  });
}

// Closed section loops, with normals taken from the continuous surface.
function surface(parent,name,u0,u1,rows,sides,point,color) {
  const pos=[],norm=[],col=[],index=[];
  const origin=parent.getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
  const eu=(u1-u0)*.00013, ea=.001;
  for(let j=0;j<=rows;j++){
    const u=mix(u0,u1,j/rows);
    for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){
      const a=TAU*i/sides;
      const p=point(u,a);
      const d0=point(Math.max(u0,u-eu),a), d1=point(Math.min(u1,u+eu),a);
      const e0=point(u,a-ea), e1=point(u,a+ea);
      const dy=new THREE.Vector3(d1[0]-d0[0],d0[1]-d1[1],d1[2]-d0[2]);
      const da=new THREE.Vector3(e1[0]-e0[0],e0[1]-e1[1],e1[2]-e0[2]);
      const n=dy.cross(da).normalize();
      pos.push(p[0]-98-origin.x,294-p[1]-origin.y,p[2]-origin.z);
      norm.push(n.x,n.y,n.z);
      const c=color(p,u,a);
      col.push(c[0]/255,c[1]/255,c[2]/255);
      if(j<rows){
        const k=j*sides+i, h=j*sides+(i+1)%sides;
        index.push(k,k+sides,h+sides,k,h+sides,h);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(norm,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  geo.setIndex(index);
  geo.computeBoundingSphere();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,skin);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function faceRelief(x,y){
  if(y>70) return 0;
  return 2.4*spot(x,y,91.2,34.7,8.0,3.5)+
         2.0*spot(x,y,111.7,34.3,6.7,3.1)-
         1.25*spot(x,y,91.3,38.5,6.8,2.1)-
         1.05*spot(x,y,112.5,38.0,5.7,2.0)+
         2.7*spot(x,y,103.5,39.7,5.6,6.3)+
         4.4*spot(x,y,103.2,45.7,11.4,4.2)+
         1.65*spot(x,y,102,52.2,10.9,4.0)+
         1.2*spot(x,y,86.5,45,5.5,6.8);
}
function frontDepth(x,y){
  const [cx,rx,cz,rz]=section(trunkProfile,y);
  const c=Math.sqrt(Math.max(.0001,1-((x-cx)/rx)**2));
  return cz+rz*c+faceRelief(x,y)*smooth(0,.65,c);
}
function core(y,a){
  const [cx,rx,cz,rz]=section(trunkProfile,y);
  const sn=Math.sin(a), cs=Math.cos(a), t=Math.acos(clamp(cs,-1,1));
  const split=smooth(193,224,y);
  const x=cx+rx*mix(sn, Math.sign(sn)*(.5-.5*Math.cos(2*t)),split);
  let z=cz+mix(rz*cs,22.6*Math.sin(2*t),split);
  if(y<70) z+=faceRelief(x,y)*smooth(0,.65,cs);
  return [x,y,z];
}

// Curved elliptical sweeps keep the palms and individual digits volumetric.
function sweep(parent,name,knots,pigment,rows=32,sides=24){
  const data=knots.map((p,i)=>[i,...p]);
  function sample(u,a){
    const v=section(data,u);
    const lo=section(data,Math.max(0,u-.002));
    const hi=section(data,Math.min(knots.length-1,u+.002));
    const t=new THREE.Vector3(hi[0]-lo[0],hi[1]-lo[1],hi[2]-lo[2]).normalize();
    const lateral=new THREE.Vector3(t.y,-t.x,0).normalize();
    const front=lateral.clone().cross(t).normalize();
    const l=v[3]*Math.sin(a), d=v[4]*Math.cos(a);
    return [v[0]+l*lateral.x+d*front.x,v[1]+l*lateral.y+d*front.y,
            v[2]+l*lateral.z+d*front.z];
  }
  return surface(parent,name,0,knots.length-1,rows,sides,sample,pigment);
}

// Small lenticular folds laid along the actual curvature of the face.
function fold(parent,name,x0,x1,line,height,depth,lift,pigment){
  const point=(u,a)=>{
    const x=mix(x0,x1,u);
    const taper=.012+.988*Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.sin(Math.PI*u)),.7);
    const y=line(u)-height*taper*Math.sin(a);
    const z=frontDepth(x,y)+taper*(lift+depth*Math.cos(a));
    return [x,y,z];
  };
  return surface(parent,name,0,1,32,18,point,pigment);
}
for(const left of [true,false]){

  fold(lid,'Lower lid',x0+.15,x1, u=>curve(u)+.65,.68,.48,.14,
    ()=>[223,176,53]);
  fold(lid,'Narrow eye opening',x0,x1,curve,.39,.39,.40,
    (p,u)=>blend([199,164,53],[140,124,49],.82*Math.sin(Math.PI*u)));
  fold(lid,'Upper lid',x0-.25,x1+.15,u=>curve(u)-.94,1.15,.78,.13,
    (p,u,a)=>blend([220,172,44],[238,189,52],.35+.35*Math.sin(a)));
}

const mouthLine=u=>48.95+.67*Math.sin(Math.PI*u)+.53*(u-.5);
fold(mouth,'Lower lip',92.1,114.2,u=>mouthLine(u)+1.08,1.16,.88,.13,
  ()=>[222,160,57]);

  (p,u,a)=>blend([225,169,51],[241,187,58],.5+.42*Math.sin(a)));
fold(mouth,'Resting mouth crease',91.9,114.4,mouthLine,.59,.61,.49,
  (p,u)=>blend([196,149,47],[115,89,42],.85*Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*u),.67)));

function render(t) {

}
